from pathlib import Path
folder=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs')
folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
                if rr >= h or cc < 0 or cc >= w or grid[rr][cc] != color:
                    continue
                # Extend the diagonal pair at both ends, stopping at other marks.
                for sr, sc in ((-dr, -dc), (dr, dc)):
                    ar, ac = (r, c) if sr == -dr else (rr, cc)
                    while 0 <= ar + sr < h and 0 <= ac + sc < w:
                        ar += sr
                        ac += sc
                        if out[ar][ac] != bg:
                            break
                        out[ar][ac] = color
    return out
'''

# Verify the saved task program against the remaining demo structures.
nsf={};exec(path.read_text(),nsf); ft=nsf['transform']
# Demo 4 sparse points
D4=[[2]*20 for _ in range(18)]
for r,c,v in [(4,16,7),(5,14,6),(5,15,7),(6,14,6),(6,15,8),(7,13,6),(7,16,8)]:D4[r][c]=v
O4=ft(D4)
exp4={(r,20-r) for r in range(1,5)} | {(r,19-r) for r in range(8,18)} | {(r,10+r) for r in range(8,11)}
act4={(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(O4) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x!=D4[r][c]}
print('demo4',act4==exp4,sorted(act4),sorted(exp4))
# Demo 5/6 should not change
D5=[[7]*21 for _ in range(25)]
for r,c,v in [(23,3,2),(23,4,0),(24,3,5),(24,4,5)]:D5[r][c]=v
D6=[[4]*12 for _ in range(26)]
for r,c,v in [(22,10,0),(22,11,9),(23,10,8),(23,11,1)]:D6[r][c]=v
print('demo5 unchanged',ft(D5)==D5,'demo6 unchanged',ft(D6)==D6)
# Demo 7 expected additions: 5 extends down-left from (3,11) through row5 c9; other rays blocked/outside.
D7=[[4]*19 for _ in range(6)]
for r,c,v in [(0,11,0),(1,12,0),(0,14,9),(1,13,9),(2,12,5),(2,13,9),(3,11,5),(3,14,4),(4,14,9)]:D7[r][c]=v
O7=ft(D7)
exp7={(4,10),(5,9)}
act7={(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(O7) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x!=D7[r][c]}
print('demo7',act7==exp7,act7)
